name: Hamidreza Modares
title: Associate Professor
fitReason: Good algorithmic match for safe learned perception in physical feedback loops and data-driven control. Hardware evidence combines a CNN state estimator with robust MPC rather than end-to-end learned motor control.

physicalEvidence.summary: September 2025 primary study deploys RobotPerceptionNet plus zonotopic estimation and robust MPC on a real Husarion ROSbot XL with Jetson Orin Nano, overhead Astra Pro Plus camera and ROS2/Wi-Fi control. The constrained 2×2 m experiment learns position from preprocessed robot-marker images; orientation is supplied separately. It is not an outdoor autonomous-car demonstration. MSU author collaboration is verified; exclusive ownership/access by either individual lab is not established.
